The '''Battle of Rishi''' was a conflict that occurred above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The [[Order of Revan]] and their [[Nova Blades]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] allies manipulated the two galactic powers into shifting their patrol routes and eventually forced a confrontation above Rishi, where [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] hoped to wipe out both fleets using a Revanite fleet and Revanite saboteurs aboard the opposing fleets. The Nova Blades set up a signal jammer on the planet, cutting off all unauthorized transmissions from the planet to the fleets once they entered orbit. However, a small team of Imperial and Republic agents disabled the Revanites' signal jammer on Rishi and managed to warn the two fleets, allowing both factions to capture the saboteurs in their ranks and bring the fighting to an end.

==Behind the scenes==
The Battle of Rishi is depicted within the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' MMORPG as part of the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan|Shadow of Revan]] expansion storyline. The details of the battle, particularly the number of ships of each participating side, vary between each cutscene, making a definitive count difficult.
